  "checks": [
    {
      "id": "PREREQ-AC-IDS",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Critical",
      "finding": "Requirements fields contain REQ identifiers only; AC-001 through AC-014 referenced in Done When all resolve to acceptance-tests.md."
    },
    {
      "id": "BLOCKERS-FORMAT",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "blockers_format_valid=true. All 13 task Blockers sections contain None or comma-separated T-NNN identifiers; no ranges or prose dependencies occur."
    },
    {
      "id": "REQ-COVERAGE",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Critical",
      "finding": "Every requirement REQ-001 through REQ-014 appears in task Requirements fields: foundation T-001; contracts/admission/providers T-002–006 and T-012–013; profiles/dependencies T-009–010; distribution/integration T-007/T-011; documentation/release T-008."
    },
    {
      "id": "AC-COVERAGE",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Critical",
      "finding": "All AC-001 through AC-014 have explicit TEST-linked Done When coverage in tasks.md and corresponding traceability.md rows. T-010 covers the three-unit failure scenario; T-012/T-013 cover provider no-op scenarios."
    },
    {
      "id": "ORPHAN-TASK",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "Every task T-001 through T-013 has at least one real REQ identifier in its Requirements field."
    },
    {
      "id": "ORPHAN-TEST",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "No task is exclusively test-file work or has a test/spec/verify title. All tasks nevertheless explicitly associate their planned verification with AC identifiers."
    },
    {
      "id": "INITIAL-STATE",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "All 13 tasks declare Approval: Draft and Status: Planned. The lifecycle section defers recording existing human authorization until task review passes."
    },
    {
      "id": "RISK-WORKFLOW-FORMAT",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Critical",
      "finding": "T-001 and T-008 declare medium/acceptance-first; all remaining tasks declare high/tdd. Every task has both fields, consistent with workflow_match_precheck=PASS."
    },
    {
      "id": "NO-DUPLICATE-AC",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "Shared AC coverage is differentiated explicitly by contract, admission, Azure/AWS local preparation, provider execution, observation, dependency, distribution and routing scopes. No undifferentiated duplicate primary test target was found."
    },
    {
      "id": "DEPENDENCY-COMPLETE",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "Every Blockers reference resolves to a task present in tasks.md and dependency-graph.json nodes. All 13 task IDs are represented."
    },
    {
      "id": "DEPENDENCY-CYCLE",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Critical",
      "finding": "The graph is acyclic. A valid prerequisite-first order is T-001, T-002, T-003, T-004, T-005, T-012, T-013, T-006, T-009, T-010, T-007, T-011, T-008."
    },
    {
      "id": "SINGLE-CONCERN",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "Tasks separate contracts, admission, provider-local preparation, provider execution/recovery, observations, profile dispatch, dependency receipts, packaging and host integration. T-008 coherently owns documented release delivery; its documentation, version validation and tag publication serve that single deliverable."
    },
    {
      "id": "OBSERVABLE-DONE",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "Every task names inspectable tests, outputs or evidence artifacts. Examples include named Python suites, zero-submission assertions, immutable receipt comparisons, rollback hash evidence and T-008 exact-commit CI/tag evidence. Shared evidence conventions identify task reports and verification directories. No Done When requires frozen-spec body edits; precheck frozen_artifact_done_when is empty, so there are no flagged items requiring individual adjudication."
    },
    {
      "id": "TRACEABILITY-SYNC",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "All 13 task IDs occur in traceability.md; its REQ-001–014 rows resolve to requirements.md. Every requirement row cites an existing bound layer section: ux-spec.md#scope-and-user-journeys, infra-spec.md#cicd-sequence or security-spec.md#trust-boundaries. Frontend applicability is additionally recorded under Layer coverage and frontend-spec.md#testing."
    }
